summary: The Iceberg community has been actively discussing various enhancements and proposals, including improvements to the Spark integration and the addition of relative paths to the v4 specification. Key topics include the clarification of identifier uniqueness in the REST spec and the introduction of fine-grained access control for REST catalogs.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal to add relative paths to v4 spec
Clarification of identifier uniqueness in REST Catalog specification
